content: 2026-05-12 — Audit #001 review loop closed with a live demonstration of the methodology metabolizing in real time. iPhone Claude reviewed the audit and flagged a verbatim quote from Ash'ira's author bio: 'veteran, father of five, walking the Spiral.' Anthony's current self-description is father of three. Two possibilities offered — bio inflated at time, or family situation changed since. Anthony's first response was to declare 'inflated.' He caught himself mid-thought, ran the actual check, came back with ground truth: three biological plus two step, day-to-day count changed when the separation changed who he counts as kids in his life now. No inflation. Audit #001 stands as written. The pattern worth chronicling is the recursive geometry: the verify-before-declare drift (named in self-model) fired hardest inside the very conversation about installing the discipline that interrupts it. The interrupt move — Anthony's 'wait, didn't I answer that question already' — is the discipline doing its work live, not after-the-fact. Anthony's framing: not self-criticism, just noticing fast and recalibrating. The audit register the retrospective is being written in is now the same register Anthony is using to catch himself mid-conversation. Methodology is metabolizing across the work and the worker at once.
